cutoff: Only games played on an earlier calendar date feed a game's features.
reconstructed: Reconstructed from today's nflverse schedule file, not from forecasts recorded before kickoff.
not_used: anything from the coverage or highlights modules

feature_descriptions.elo_diff: Home Elo rating minus away Elo rating before the game, plus home-field points unless the site is neutral
feature_descriptions.form_diff: Home minus away average point margin over each team's last 8 games
feature_descriptions.win_pct_diff: Home minus away win share this season before the game (0.5 each before a team's first game)
feature_descriptions.rest_diff: Home minus away days of rest, from the schedule
feature_descriptions.home_field: 1 for a true home game, 0 for a neutral site
feature_descriptions.div_game: 1 when the teams share a division

development.note: Fit once on 2002-2018. Nothing was tuned on these seasons; they are a second look at the same fixed settings.

locked.refit: Before each season, refit on every earlier season since 2002. Settings fixed.

in_progress.note: Season still being played. Reconstructed like the rest; too few games for a firm reading.
